about: The quarters of a generated town (the owner, 6 November: a town of recognizable, navigable organization, not a directory): each a part of the town a player can learn, walked to by its heart, holding the places whose role it lists. A town of more than a few places is given those of its quarters it has a place for (a town with no waterside has no waterside quarter); a place of another module in the town (a going-on's ground, a scenario's yard) is in the quarter its role names here, else in that of the place it opens off, else with the green. Each place keeps its containment in the town; a quarter is only where it lies. An adventure that adds a place to a town says its quarter with inQuarter (data/rules/core.kyr). Add a role to a quarter here, or a quarter: nothing in the engine needs to change.
